newsitem.title: GERMANY: RWE sees higher year 96/97 net earnings.
newsitem.headline: RWE sees higher year 96/97 net earnings.

text.p: German diversified utility RWE AG said on Wednesday it expected a rise in full-year earnings for 1996/97 after reporting a 7.7 percent rise in group net operating profit in the first half.
"We expect that full-year earnings will be higher overall than in the previous year," RWE said in its interim statement.
In the six months to the end of December, RWE saw group profit after tax and minority interests rise to 573 million marks, up from 532 million marks in the same period a year ago.

Turnover at RWE also grew in the period to 36.09 billion marks from 32.46 billion. The group's main sales generator, its energy unit, saw a small decline in sales of 1.4 percent to 10.4 billion marks in the period.
RWE said that its results included costs for its telecommunications business of 82 million marks, and said it expected higher costs in this sector in second half of the 1996/97 business year.
